title: CoreWeave Says They Have 10X Demand Compared to Available Supply | CRWV Stock Deep Dive Part 4
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Parkevtate breaks down CoreWeave's Q3 results, which sent the stock up more than 25% on the day. Management said demand is 10 times available capacity for 2027, with 2028 demand already several times capacity before it is even built, and pricing is up at least 25% from the previous quarter — 35% by one reading — and still rising in early Q4, because customers are seeing real returns on their AI spend. Revenue backlog ended the quarter at about $133bn, up 138% year over year, with more than half attached to contracts where delivery starts by the end of this year. Management also spent considerable time on the big investor concern, cash flow: they reaffirmed that contracted cash flow from customer commitments should service and repay outstanding debt, asset-level and parent-level, plus any additional debt raised to deliver the contracts, before counting renewals. Parkevtate praises management for underestimating demand and overdelivering — low double-digit margins arrived a quarter ahead of plan — contrasting it with EV companies that overbuilt for demand that never came. He notes Nvidia's 17 November earnings will reveal much more about the AI industry and will go live for channel members. Call: CRWV UNCERTAIN (no explicit call; prior explicit stance remains BUY from 14 Nov). Note: captions garble the pricing figure (25% vs 35%) in one passage.
